title: Private Princess Christmas
overview: Princess Violet of Wingravia must complete a tough leadership boot camp in Colorado or risk losing her throne to her uncle.

title: A Holiday Spectacular
overview: In 1958, Maggie is an heiress from Philadelphia who puts her high-society wedding plans on hold in order to sneak to New York City and make her secret dream of dancing live on stage in the Christmas Spectacular at Radio City Music Hall come true.
